ITEM 1 | Bundle of about 10-12 slender green spears, bright green with pale yellow-green cut ends, firm and smooth-skinned, tips slightly pointed and closed, spears roughly 15-20 cm long and 0.8-1 cm thick, lying loosely in a cluster across the lower-left part of the plate, slight moisture sheen, no visible browning or char | 90

ITEM 2 | Single triangular wedge of flatbread-style pizza, about 12 cm along the outer crust edge and 10 cm deep, golden-tan crust with dark charred and blistered edges along the outer rim, topped with melted pale cheese showing light browning and scattered orange-red tomato sauce spots, cheese slightly glossy, sitting on the right side of the plate with the pointed tip toward the center | 120
